name: Of Valkyries and Life
source:
What would you do if you woke up one day with wings grown on your back?

Of Valkyries and Life is a compilation of short stories, all built around the theme of winged girls: A story of a winged girl who lived in ancient Finland, another winged girl who was worshiped as a Valkyrie in the times of Vikings, and lastly a tomboy from modern day Japan, all struggling to find a way to live with their wings.

The stories are largely kinetic and can be played in any order, there is a total of 5 different endings. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26956]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
如果有一天你一觉醒来，背上长出了翅膀，你会做什么？

《女武神与生命》是一部短篇小说集，全部围绕着翅膀女孩的主题展开：一个生活在古代芬兰的翅膀女孩，另一个在维京时代被崇拜为女武神的翅膀女孩，最后一个来自现代日本的假小子，他们都在努力寻找一种用翅膀生存的方式。

故事大部分是动态的，可以按任何顺序播放，共有5个不同的结局。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26956]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
